description: Build a dry-run plan that would make the target store match the source (a store or a "dir:<path>" snapshot folder) for the selected resources. Reads both sides and writes nothing. Returns { plan_id, expiresAt, totals (create, update, conflict), byResource, ops, warnings, filesToUpload, onlyInTarget, targetWritable, targetProtected }; each op has a seq number, key, action, reason, missing references and field changes (the first 200 ops are listed). Conflicts are items that can't be written, with the reason; items only in the target are listed and never deleted. Show the plan to the person, then pass plan_id to apply_plan; it expires after one hour, and get_plan shows it again. To only look at differences, use diff_stores instead.

as_drafts.description: Leave the published state out of what is compared and copied: in a plan, new pages are created hidden and new metaobject entries as drafts, and existing ones keep their state. Products are always created as drafts.

collection_products.description: collections: also compare and copy which products are picked by hand into manual collections, matched by handle. Added, never removed. Off by default (one read per manual collection).

currency_rates.description: Exchange rates for stores that sell in different currencies, like {"MAD:EUR": 0.092} (the reverse rate is used too). Product prices (with prices), catalog fixed prices and market currencies are converted with them. Without a rate, prices in another currency are left out and the plan says so; a percentage price list follows the target's currency.

exclude.description: Drop keys matching any of these globs.

include.description: Only keys matching one of these globs, e.g. ["PRODUCT.custom.*", "faq/*", "fr:*"].

include_reserved.description: metafield_definitions: also compare Shopify-reserved ones (namespace "shopify", the category metafields that drive storefront filters). Compared only: a plan reports them as conflicts and never writes them.

inventory.description: products: include stock (the available quantity per location, matched to the target's location with the same name) in what is read, compared and planned. Off by default. Needs read_inventory and read_locations, plus write_inventory to apply: run connect again if the sign-in is older.

locales.description: Limit translations to these locales, e.g. ["fr", "de"]. Default: every non-primary locale.

market_translations.description: translations: also read the translations each market overrides, keyed "<locale>@<market handle>:<Type>/<handle>", and register them for the market of the same handle in the target. Off by default (one read per market, language and resource type).

metaobject_types.description: Limit metaobjects to these types. Default: all non-reserved types.

namespaces.description: Limit metafield values (metafields) to these namespaces.

owner_types.description: Metafield owner types. For metafield_definitions, default: PRODUCT, PRODUCTVARIANT, COLLECTION, CUSTOMER, ORDER, DRAFTORDER, COMPANY, COMPANY_LOCATION, LOCATION, MARKET, PAGE, BLOG, ARTICLE, SHOP. For metafield values (metafields): PRODUCT, COLLECTION, PRODUCTVARIANT, SHOP (all by default).

prices.description: products: include variant prices and compare-at prices; catalogs: include fixed prices in price lists. Read, compared and planned only when on. Off by default, since prices usually differ per store.

resources.description: Resource types to include. Default: metafield_definitions, metaobject_definitions, collections, pages, shop_policies, metaobjects, menus, redirects. products, metafields, translations, discounts, locations, markets, catalogs and sales_channels are opt-in.

source.description: Store alias, or "dir:<path>" for a snapshot folder made with export_snapshot.

target.description: Store alias the plan would write to (see list_stores; snapshot folders can't be a target).

type_mismatch.description: plan_sync only, when a metafield has one type in the source and another in the target (e.g. single_line_text_field and list.single_line_text_field). Default: reported as a conflict and skipped. "convert_values": keep the target definition's type and convert the source values to it (a value becomes a list of one; a list of one becomes a value). "retype_definitions": give the target definition the source's type; Shopify can't change a type in place, so it is deleted and created again, its values saved to a backup file first and written back converted. Needs metafield_definitions in resources.
